notes: The API requires periodId (YYYYMM) or lastModifiedDateTime, and rejects a lastModifiedDateTime more than 6 months back unless periodId is set, so a fixed lastModifiedDateTime default turns into a 400 on a first sync as soon as it ages (measured 2026-09-30 on 7 tenants). period_scan walks periodId from first_period to 12 months past the current month: future periods hold real batches (pilot: 63 lines in 202610, 4 in 202612; none from 202701), unlike general_ledger_balances_v2. totalCount and pageSize count LINES, not batches; a batch can span pages and is merged afterwards. page_size 1000 is the API maximum (maxPageSize). Pilot: first period with data 202201, 25,578 lines in 202609. DataMart's dm_journal_transactions holds the same lines (573,369 in the pilot). resume: a scheduled run applies the checkpoint's lastModifiedDateTime inside each period (periodId stays set, which the API demands for a lastModifiedDateTime older than 6 months), so it is one short request per period, and a full pass walks every period unfiltered.
